summary: License amendment & SCIM onboarding for ModelTweak tuning platform (40 seats, proration, SSO/SCIM)
description:
Issue summary:
We need to finalize a 40-seat annual license amendment with ModelTweak (model-tuning SaaS) and complete SSO/SCIM onboarding. The current eval contract has 10 seats (expires 2026-03-31). The vendor provided a pro-rated quote to align renewal to our fiscal year (renewal date 2027-01-01).

Impact:
- Research & Applied ML (10 FTEs) and Platform ML (5 FTEs) currently using eval seats will lose access after 2026-03-31 if not converted.
- Delay will block two active tuning engagements and slow scheduled model finetuning pilots.

Business justification:
- ModelTweak has unique optimizer integrations that reduce tuning runs by ~30% on CPU/GPU spend per pilot; required for Q2 customer POC.

Environment:
- Vendor SaaS, vendor-hosted. Integrations required: SSO (SAML, Okta), SCIM user provisioning, and IP allowlist for dedicated liaison.

Requirements / Acceptance criteria:
1) PO created and approved by Finance with cost center 4302-ML-Prod by 2026-03-22.
2) Security questionnaire reviewed and signed (InfoSec).
3) SCIM mapping implemented (groups: ml-research, ml-platform) and tested in staging.
4) SSO SAML metadata exchanged and Okta app configured.
5) Seats provisioned and verified with Product owners.

Steps taken so far:
- Vendor quote received 2026-03-05 (attached).
- Security questionnaire (VSA) returned 2026-03-07; InfoSec requested clarifications on encryption-at-rest SLA.
- Legal requested standard DPA + minimal amendments; preparing PO template.

Deadline:
- Target: convert eval to paid seats and enable SSO by 2026-03-25 to avoid access gap.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Aisha Patel: Opening ticket. Attached vendor quote and eval agreement. Requesting Finance routing and InfoSec review.
2026-03-10 15:04 - Finance (Liam Chen): Can you confirm total annual cost and whether the vendor accepts a net-30 PO or requires prepay? Need exact invoice terms to route approvals.

2026-03-11 09:23 - Vendor (ModelTweak Rep - Jana Novak): We can accept net-30 for the first year; proration to 2027-01-01 shown on quote. We will start SCIM once PO is signed and SAML metadata exchanged.
2026-03-11 11:45 - Diego Morales: Assigned to me for SSO/SCIM coordination. Will provision a staging Okta app and share metadata. Requesting test account list from Product owners.
2026-03-11 16:30 - InfoSec (Priya Rao): Reviewed VSA; need clarification on KMS usage and whether customer-managed keys are supported. Marked as minor hold until vendor confirms.
2026-03-12 08:02 - Aisha Patel: Shared cost-center (4302-ML-Prod) and approved list of 8 immediate users for pilot testing. Updated deadline to 2026-03-25.
2026-03-12 14:20 - Legal (Marco Alvarez): Drafted DPA with minimal changes. Waiting on vendor signature. If vendor signs DPA by EOD 2026-03-15 we can proceed with PO creation.
investigation_notes: Verified vendor's eval tenant URL and telemetry: https://app.modeltweak.io (staging).
Confirmed the vendor supports SCIM 2.0 and SAML 2.0 (per vendor docs).
InfoSec requested encryption-at-rest cert and whether KMS/HSM customer-keying is supported; vendor responded 'not currently' but offered data-segmentation guarantees.
Finance noted the vendor's bank details for ACH; procurement must confirm tax handling for EU teams if we expand seats to eu-west later.
resolution: In progress: PO draft created, DPA sent to vendor 2026-03-12. Next steps: vendor to sign DPA and return SAML metadata (due 2026-03-15). Once DPA is signed, Finance to issue PO net-30; Diego to complete Okta app and SCIM mapping in staging and run verification with product owners. Follow-up ticket to validate production provisioning will be opened once staging test passes.
notes: Risk: if vendor cannot support customer-managed keys, InfoSec may restrict seat expansion beyond pilot; mitigation: limit initial 40 seats to non-sensitive projects and revisit KMS requirements for enterprise rollout.
